title: Google Inc - proposed acquisition of DoubleClick Inc

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Former proposed date of 16 October 2007 for announcement of ACCC's findings amended by 2 weeks at request of ACCC to allow additional time to consider new information.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.
